title: Plot & Conflict
summary: Shape a story mountain, choose a conflict, and control pacing so readers can't stop reading.
bigIdeas: Every story climbs a mountain: beginning, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution.
A good ending shows what changed.

projectSpec.title: My Story Mountain Story
projectSpec.description: Write a complete story (1,000–1,500 words). Plan it on a story mountain first, choose one main conflict, build the rising action, slow down and speed up on purpose, and finish with a resolution that shows how your character has changed.
